    Description
    BehaviourKey<T>
    A typed behaviour property of blocks or items: what Bedrock Dedicated Server knows about vanilla content but never sends to clients (friction, destroy time, collision shapes, attack damage, ...).
    BehaviourKey.Owner
    Whose property a key is.
    BlockBehaviour
    The behaviour keys of block states, read with palette.resolve(state).behaviour().get(key) (BlockValues).
    BlockShape
    Boxes in block space (0 to 1 on each axis; fences and walls reach 1.5 in y), relative to the block's minimum corner.
    BlockShape.Box
    One axis aligned box.
    BlockValues
    The behaviour values of one block state in one palette: palette.resolve(state).behaviour().
    BooleanKey
    A behaviour key whose values are booleans: get returns them unboxed.
    FloatKey
    A behaviour key whose values are floats: get returns them unboxed.
    IntKey
    A behaviour key whose values are ints: get returns them unboxed.
    ItemBehaviour
    The behaviour keys of item types, read with palette.resolve(variant).behaviour().get(key) (ItemValues).
    ItemValues
    The behaviour values of one item type in one palette: palette.resolve(BedrockItems.APPLE).behaviour().
    ObjectKey<T>
    A behaviour key whose values are objects (String, BlockShape).
